newsitem.title: USA: G10 to make up 80 pct of IMF's NAB scheme - Japan.
newsitem.headline: G10 to make up 80 pct of IMF's NAB scheme - Japan.

text.p: The Group of Ten (G10) countries would make up for about 80 percent of the enhanced war chest that will be used to help countries overwhelmed by economic crisis similar to the Mexican debacle, a Japanese Ministry of Finance (MOF) official said on Sunday.

He added that about 13 countries, which have expressed their intention of joining this so called New Arrangements to Borrow (NAB) will make up for the rest. The 13 countries include nations such as South Korea, Singapore, Thailand, Australia, Finland, Norway, Spain, and Saudi Arabia.
"The G10 countries have agreed in principle (on NAB) ... I think it is a great step forward," the MOF official said.
Japan's share in the current GAB is at 12.5 percent, which would become 13.25 percent in the NAB scheme. The overall amount of the pool of funds has yet to be finalised, he added.

Although the outlook as to when this enhanced war chest would start remains unclear, the G10 nations agreed that the scheme would take off once 85 percent of the countries in the scheme take necessary procesures to participate.
G10 also agreed that countries in the NAB scheme would meet once a year, he said.
